verdict.rationale: Copilot's own docs describe a PR code review feature. It gives feedback with suggested changes you can apply in a couple of clicks, and labels each comment with a severity level. The documented flow is 'request a code review', though, and nothing shows reviews running automatically on every pull request. The automation docs cover the cloud agent, not code review. missing for 10: documented automatic review triggered on every pull request, independent or hands-on corroboration of review quality and context-awareness.

support.subject: As a developer, I can get automatic code review with contextual feedback on every pull request

citations.quote: GitHub Copilot can review your code and provide feedback. Where possible, Copilot's feedback includes suggested changes which you can apply with a couple of clicks.
Copilot labels each comment with a severity level of "High," "Medium," or "Low" to help you prioritize the issues it finds based on their importance.
Access to Cloud agent and code review
